scientific_question: Among inferred genetic source→destination assignments on EOG observed-positive transitions, how often is the assigned source compatible with the *same two-host ordinal environment gate* and geographic radius used by EOG? Distinguish family-row, source→destination pair, and target-year grain and the existential-vs-assigned source inequality.

encrypted_bridge.encryption: same authenticated RSA-OAEP+AES-GCM as prior v1, new ephemeral key only in local current runtime

predeclared_derived_metrics.genetics_movement: PatchFrom != PatchTo (two destinations not independent family units)
predeclared_derived_metrics.genetic_source_eligible: YearFrom patch has recorded population>0 and complete original Plantago+Veronica score in 0-3 and mapped centroid
predeclared_derived_metrics.genetic_target_eligible: YearFrom destination patch recorded population==0 and YearTo destination population>0, YearFrom destination has valid two-host scores and mapped centroid
predeclared_derived_metrics.host_delta: max absolute difference of both original survey Plantago and Veronica 0..3 scores at YearFrom, source vs destination
predeclared_derived_metrics.primary_scope: off-patch assignments with both EOG target and source eligible; expected 163 rows and 100 targets from frozen v1; do not quietly retune
predeclared_derived_metrics.universe: EOG prior-year recorded-positive source roster as previous crosswalk; all source candidates use original same-year host values
statuses_for_each_tolerance: assigned source host-compatible with delta (where source eligibility holds)
nearest permitted observed-positive source radius for delta
existential EOG coverage at each r, even if assigned source is incompatible with delta
assigned origin r/host compatible at same r and delta
EOG existential yes but assigned source unavailable/out-of-bounds: interpretation difference, not predictive false-positive
controls: Strictly nested host thresholds and geographic radii preserve EOG existential coverage monotonicity
On eligible sources/targets at any declared delta, EOG minimum radius <= assigned-source distance for an allowed assigned source within 1e-4km tolerance
Require parent 2008..2012 EOG full eligible target/source counts match v1
If source recorded zero or missing, do NOT call assigned route a candidate under EOG t-1 positive-only policy
No alternative source selected using genetic assignment/target outcome

separate_genetic_assignment_quality.published_GENECLASS2: Assignments confined to sampled prior-year reference patches; family parts at different arrival patches were assigned separately (DiLeo et al. 2022, doi:10.1098/rspb.2022.0322). Reported score=100 threshold; NOT independently audited per row because score missing.

output_contract: Aggregate only, year x gap/r summaries and family/target-year equal weights, no source site IDs, destination site IDs, family IDs, coordinates or raw genetic rows.
scope_limits: Exploratory post-outcome same-archipelago comparison, NOT independent prediction/causal environmental filtering/dispersal kernel; no new EOG-WF endpoint 3 scored/31 scientific STOP/3 administrative exclusions unchanged.
